executive_summary: The revision of DA1840189 from TS to Rev A represents a significant drawing restructuring: the original isometric and auxiliary views (ISO_1, ISO_2, VIEW_1, SIDE, VIEW_8) have been replaced by a new view set (ISO_FRONT, ISO_REAR, MAIN_TOP, SECTION A-A, SECTION B-B, ANNOTATION), which substantially changes how the part geometry is documented and must be verified for completeness. Most critically, the left isometric view in the revised drawing appears to show the top-center raised boss or protrusion as flattened or removed — a potential functional geometry change that requires immediate design authority confirmation before release. Additionally, the pocket corner radius count was halved from 16X R.030 to 8X R.030 in Section C-C, which may reflect a re-specification of applicable corners or an actual reduction in corner breaks, with direct implications for stress concentration and machining setup. Supporting changes include a terminology update from 'HELICOIL' to 'HELICAL INSERTS' for procurement neutrality and addition of a proprietary marking, both of which are documentation-only in nature.
